defs.def: to think carefully about the different possibilities that are available and choose one of them 对 … 作出抉择；决定；选定

ex.s: I decided that I wanted to learn as many words as I could and started marking every entry I looked up with a pencil to measure my progress.
ex.t: 那时我决心要尽可能多地学单词，并开始用铅笔标记每一个查过的词条，以此来衡量自己的进步。

ex.s: Seeing no hope of immediate rescue, Emily decided to spend the night in her car.
ex.t: 眼看没有立即获救的希望，Emily决定在车里过夜。

ex.s: On their first trip out, they were greeted with such enthusiasm from the 10 families who’d already established homes there that they decided to join.
ex.t: 第一次实地探访时，已在那里安家的10户人家热情相迎，这让他们决定加入。

ex.s: What made Reisley finally decide to settle down in Usonia?
ex.t: 是什么让赖斯利最终决定在乌索尼亚定居下来？

ex.s: Unable to keep my eyes open, I decided I had no choice but to finish my homework the next morning.
ex.t: 我困得睁不开眼，于是决定别无选择，只能在第二天早上完成作业。

ex.s: After we had twins and became a family of five, my husband and I decided to move from London back to Yorkshire, to be closer to my parents.
ex.t: 在有了双胞胎、成为一个五口之家后，我和丈夫决定从伦敦搬回约克郡，以便离我的父母更近。

ex.s: Robert then decided to return to the fight, winning independence for the Scots — on the seventh attempt.
ex.t: 罗伯特随后决定重返战场，为苏格兰人赢得了独立——在第七次尝试时。

ex.s: Eventually, my brother decided to leave rather than force the issue.
ex.t: 最终，我弟弟决定离开，而不是强求。

ex.s: Instead, she recommends applying a well-known concept among nutrition experts called the “Division of Responsibility,” where parents provide a variety of mostly healthy foods to their kids at fixed times, and the kids themselves decide what and how much they want to consume — even if that means occasionally eating more cookies than carrots.
ex.t: 相反，她建议采用营养专家中一个知名的理念，叫做“责任分工”：父母在固定时间给孩子提供各种大多健康的食物，而孩子自己决定想吃什么、吃多少——即便这意味着偶尔吃更多饼干而非胡萝卜。

ex.s: Thinking that the man might get away with whatever he wanted before the police arrived, Kevin decided to do something.
ex.t: 想到那个人可能会在警察到达之前逃脱并得到他想要的任何东西，凯文决定采取行动。

ex.s: Instead of simply complaining, he decided to do something about it.
ex.t: 他决定不再只是抱怨，而是为此做点什么。

ex.s: Why did Farber decide to try acupuncture on pets?
ex.t: 为什么法伯决定在宠物身上尝试针灸？

ex.s: When I decided to buy a house in Europe ten years ago, I didn't think too long.
ex.t: 十年前我决定在欧洲买房时，没想太久。

ex.s: She decides to quit college.
ex.t: 她决定从大学退学。

ex.s: She decided that she would memorize where her classes were and then pretend that the rest of the place didn’t exist.
ex.t: 她决定记住教室的位置，然后假装其他地方都不存在。

ex.s: Eva decided to use the same trick to deal with the school building.
ex.t: 伊娃决定用同样的办法来应对学校大楼的问题。

ex.s: “I love working with kids, so I just decided to take a spare bedroom and turn it into a one-room cooking school called Sprouts Cooking School. ”
ex.t: "我喜欢和孩子们一起工作，所以我决定腾出一间闲置卧室，把它改造成一个名为'豆芽烹饪学校'的单间烹饪学校。"

ex.s: Each pair of students meets three times throughout the term with a teacher who decides if the exchange is effective.
ex.t: 每对学生整个学期与一位老师会面三次，由老师判断这种交流是否有效。

ex.s: When I decided to pursue a postgraduate degree, I wanted to develop a novel research programme and quickly establish myself as an independent scientist.
ex.t: 当我决定攻读研究生学位时，我想开发一个新颖的研究项目，并迅速确立自己作为独立科学家的地位。

ex.s: He decided to build what he would later call an eco-machine.
ex.t: 他决定建造一台他后来称之为"生态机器"的装置。

ex.s: After we found a crazy-looking road that hung over a bunch of rocks, we decided to photograph the scene at sunset.
ex.t: 在我们发现一条悬在一堆岩石上方、看起来奇特的路之后，我们决定在日落时拍摄这一场景。

ex.s: Last Friday my mom decided to color his hair.
ex.t: 上周五我妈妈决定染头发。

ex.s: In my early thirties, I decided to climb Mount Kilimanjaro, the highest mountain in Africa at 5, 895 meters above sea level.
ex.t: 30年代初，我决定登上乞力马扎罗山，这是非洲最高的山峰，海拔5,895米。

ex.s: Since it wasn't dark yet after the meal, I decided to walk home from the restaurant.
ex.t: 因为饭后天还没黑，我决定从餐厅走路回家。

ex.s: He hesitated and then said he had decided not to run.
ex.t: 他犹豫了一下，然后说他决定不跑了。

ex.s: “I gave him the choice to run or not, and let him decide.”
ex.t: "我给了他选择跑或不跑的权利，让他自己决定。"

ex.t: 当她从舞蹈事业退休，儿子们最终离巢后，她决定是时候迈出这一步了。

ex.s: “I just decided I wanted to go,” she says.
ex.t: “我只是决定我想去，”她说。

ex.s: I decided to stick to it no matter what.
ex.t: 我决定无论如何都要坚持下去。

ex.t: 作为同伴小组，你们决定每次活动涵盖什么内容。

ex.s: She decided to go back to college to advance her career and to be able to better support her family while doing something she loves: nursing.
ex.t: 她决定回到大学深造，以推进自己的事业，并在从事自己热爱的工作——护理——的同时，更好地支撑家庭。

ex.s: His judgment and references are decidedly American, as well as his delicate stomach.
ex.t: 他的判断和参考明显是美国式的他那脆弱的胃也是如此。

ex.t: 我决定想出一个方法 对付被禁止的水果。

ex.s: Scientists in Louisiana were so concerned that they decided to pay hunters $5 a tail.
ex.t: 路易斯安那州的科学家如此担忧，于是决定按每条尾巴付给猎人5美元。

ex.s: I decided to play with him with only one toy for as long as it would keep his interest I expected that one toy would keep his attention for about five minutes, ten minutes, max I chose a red rubber ball—simple, universally available.
ex.t: 我决定只用一个玩具陪他玩，只要还能吸引他的兴趣就行；我估计一个玩具大概能让他专注五分钟，最多十分钟。我选了一个红色的橡皮球——简单、随处可见。

ex.s: Benjamin could read only a little,having been a poor student.But he later said,”Those two books were my companions by day,and under my pillow at night.”While it is likely that he understood very little of the books,they were his introduction to classical paintings.The nine-year-old boy decided then that he would be an artist.
ex.t: 本杰明只读过一点书，因为他曾是个差学生。但他后来说：“那两本书白天是我的伙伴，晚上就在我的枕头下。”虽然他很可能几乎看不懂那些书，但它们是他接触古典绘画的入门。这个九岁男孩当时就下定决心要成为一名艺术家。
